name: Phuong Huu Vu Tran
tagline: Computer Science Undergraduate · Reliable AI · Multimodal Learning
short_bio: I research reliable AI through multimodal retrieval, evidence verification, and neuro-symbolic reasoning.
bio: I am a Computer Science undergraduate at Vietnamese-German University researching reliable AI. My work connects multimodal retrieval, evidence verification, and neuro-symbolic reasoning, with a common focus on making model outputs more trustworthy under noisy evidence, evolving knowledge, and changes in input formulation.

I have worked with PAMI Lab, RAISE Lab, Dream AI Lab, and Transformers Lab on multimodal retrieval, reliable RAG, executable verification, and legal-document RAG. I have contributed to peer-reviewed work at ICDM 2026, ArgMining/ACL 2026, and the AI City Challenge Workshop at ECCV 2026.
